title: Twilight Zone sponsorship in the 1959-60 trade press (Sponsor, Variety, Broadcasting)
description: The Media History Digital Library has digitized 1959-60 issues of the trade magazines Sponsor, Variety, Broadcasting and Television Digest. Searching its Lantern tool for The Twilight Zone returns pages from these magazines, which are where the show's sponsor deals and network promotion would have appeared. TV Obscurities has an exhibit of vintage sponsor spots. TVLine and /Film have written about the show's early sponsors, including one that dropped out because it never understood the show, and about sponsors refusing a dark season 2 script. Which pages carry actual advertisements, as opposed to news items, has not been checked.
tz_connection: Records of who paid for the original series and how CBS sold it to advertisers.
recommendation_reason: These are legitimately hosted archive scans and the best available path to real sponsor ads, but each page needs checking.
